Evelyn (CEO): Morning team — quick exec weekly note. High level: product momentum is good, infra cost trending down 3% MoM, but we saw a small spike in tail latency on Wed. Priorities this week: (1) ship Dedicated capacity autoscaling tweaks, (2) freeze breaking model changes until rollout window, (3) tighten cost/latency dashboards for top 10 customers.
Sam (VP Product): Thanks — can you share the SLA targets you want us to hold for the Dedicated rollout?
Evelyn (CEO): Target: p95 < 220ms for 2k token median workloads on Dedicated, p99 under 650ms. If we can't meet that we delay canary.
Rita (VP Eng): Noted. Eng will add a canary flag that forces fallback to smaller quantized model on p99 violations. ETA EOW for the flag.
Maeve (Head of Sales): Heads-up: two pilot customers in EU asked for a Private deployment trial next month. We need a clear messaging doc about expected latency and data controls.
Jon (Finance): Cost update: committed reserved nodes for Q3 pushed unit cost down; still watching GPU-hours vs burst usage. We can commit more if utilization stays > 70%.
Evelyn (CEO): Good. Maeve — we'll prioritize a 1-pager for customers. Jon — please share utilization heatmap by Fri.
Sam (VP Product): On the product side: 1) shipping function-calling alpha next week to a limited group, 2) plan to add a prompt-template library to Redwood Console. Any objections to delaying funkitty integration until post-alpha?
Rita (VP Eng): No objections. We need stability on runtime before adding more surface area. Also investigating the Wed tail-latency spike — initial signal points to a KV cache eviction storm during a batch window.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment for ded-capacity v1 started at 1951234600, will stream logs to #eng-runtime.
Evelyn (CEO): Action items: Rita — post a short incident RCA draft by Mon morning if the KV hypothesis holds. Sam — ensure canary has an automatic rollback on p99 breach. Maeve — customer 1-pager by Thu. Jon — utilization heatmap by Fri.
Maeve (Head of Sales): I'll coordinate with Solutions to draft the 1-pager and send a preview to Sales Ops by Wed.
Rita (VP Eng): Quick note on hiring: SRE and Core Runtime hiring pipelines are moving — expect two offers this week. Helps long-term reliability posture.
Jon (Finance): Also, minor policy change: starting next billing cycle we'll itemize Dedicated burst charges separately on invoices. Heads-up to billing-sensitive customers.
Evelyn (CEO): We'll announce that in the customer newsletter after we confirm invoice layout. Keep messaging simple: "separate burst charges for transparency".
Sam (VP Product): Can Marketing get a short blurb for the console changelog? I can approve.
Evelyn (CEO): Yes — coordinate with Marketing.
Rita (VP Eng): One more ops ask: eng-runtime team needs a small quota bump for perf tests tomorrow (2x temporary). Jon — ok on spend?
Jon (Finance): Approve temporary 2x, cap at $6k/day for test window. Notify FinOps when tests start.
Maeve (Head of Sales): :thumbsup: — I'll loop in AE leads for the Private trial prospects.
Evelyn (CEO): Thanks all. Quick metrics: MRR +5% MoM, Hosted API unit cost -3% MoM, Dedicated trials +2 prospects this week, incident count stable (1 Sev3 this week). Keep the momentum and tight comms.
Sam (VP Product): Thanks — will follow up with a short status thread on canary progress.
Rita (VP Eng): Will post the tail-latency logs and initial traces to #eng-runtime.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary completed at 1951234680 — no automatic rollback triggered. Logs archived at https://internal.redwood/deploys/1951234680
Evelyn (CEO): Great — wrap up and let's sync again next Friday. :sparkles:
